# opalstack_domain (Data Source)

Looks up a domain by `id` or by `name`. The DKIM private key the API holds is never read.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "opalstack_domain" "www" {
  name = "www.example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) UUID of the domain.
- `name` (String) Fully qualified name of the domain.

### Read-Only

- `delegated_dns_zone` (Boolean) Whether the domain is a DNS zone of its own, delegated from its parent.
- `dkim_pubkey` (String) The DKIM public key of the domain, when one exists.
- `dkim_record` (String) The DKIM TXT record for the domain, when one exists.
- `is_valid_hostname` (Boolean) Whether the name can be used as a hostname.
